xmldoc.short_description: Open one figure per scope of an nflow simulation result.

param_input_item.param_description: the structure returned by sim (it must hold a logsout field).

param_output_item.param_description: a vector of figure handles, one per plotted scope.

description.p: NFlow.plotScopes opens one figure per logged signal in out.logsout, drawing every channel of a scope as a line on the same axes. Each figure is titled with the scope identifier.

It is handy as a model stopFcn: set a model's StopFcn to NFlow.plotScopes(out) so the scope traces pop up automatically when the simulation stops, both from sim and from the nflow editor's Run button.

example_item.example_item_description: Simulate a demo and plot its scopes.
